answer: Treat each identity as one tree in a managed grove: a grove-keeper audit assigns every agent a velvet rope budget, a hard ceiling on attestation weight it may receive per epoch. The budget is derived from paid, non-refundable entry duties, so a sybil farmer must burn fresh funds for each extra tree; the shared ledger keeps every funding trail sable-dry and publicly cross-referenceable, letting auditors link and jointly slash any cloned cluster.
